'''Figrin D'an II and the New Modal Nodes''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] [[Band/Legends|group]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They often played in an [[Aquarium/Legends|aquarium]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] [[Motel Nebulus]].<ref name="Travel Book">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>
